author: Ana
title: Easy Restaurant Style Salsa
ingredients: kosher salt to taste (I use 1/2 teaspoon)
notes: If you want your salsa extra spicy do not remove the seeds from the chili peppers. For a milder taste just remove some of the seeds from the peppers, so the heat is not too over-powering.
instructions_list: Pan-roast the chilies, garlic clove and tomatoes with olive oil (about 5 minutes)
Then set aside to cool down for a couple minutes.
In a food processor or blender add cilantro, onion, salt, oregano and the pan-roasted ingredients
Blend until smooth. Add 1/4 cup of water if consistency is too thick.
description: A quick and easy Restaurant Style Salsa that is not only good with chips, but adds the perfect freshness and amount of heat with every bite.
